name: Czechia
spiritual_teacher: Satsangs / Buddhist centers (Prague is a major European retreat hub)
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (Flat-rate tax for živnostník from ~300 €/mo including social contributions)
it_market: Excellent (One of Central Europe's leading hubs: Prague, Brno)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter 15% PIT + mandatory health/social contributions; Ukrainian 5% single tax is not credited under DTT.
climate: Temperate (Cold winter, mild summer, few sunny days)
nature: Mountains, Forests, Rock towns (Krkonoše, Bohemian Switzerland, Šumava; no sea)
english_level: Good (Fluent English in IT and Prague; Czech is a Slavic language, quick to learn)
housing_rent: Severe crisis (Prague 600–900 € for a 1-bedroom; 400–550 € in the regions)
citizenship: 10 years (5 years PR + 5 years to passport)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Biometric or regular passport, Ukrainian internal passport. Exit stamp after 24.02.2022 is mandatory.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 05.08.2026, Czechia does NOT grant protection to military-liable men aged 18–60 without proof of military deregistration!**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: First 150 days humanitarian aid ~204 € (4860 CZK) per person if no income; rent subsidy ~121 € (3000 CZK).
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Free state accommodation only in Ostrava and for up to 90 days. Full self-paid rent thereafter.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: First 150 days comprehensive VZP insurance is paid by the state; thereafter by the employer or self-paid.
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Concessions depend on the city (pass discounts in Prague); free train only for leaving the country if status is denied.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work with Temporary Protection visa; minimum wage ~112.5 CZK/hr, high demand for specialists.

items: [Sreality.cz](https://www.sreality.cz/en) — Czechia's main and largest real estate portal (Prague, Brno, Ostrava).
[Bezrealitky.cz](https://www.bezrealitky.cz/) — rental platform **exclusively direct from owners with zero realtor commission**.
[UlovDomov.cz](https://www.ulovdomov.cz/) — listing aggregator with tenant and landlord reliability checks.
[Idnes.cz/reality](https://reality.idnes.cz/) — large catalog by media group iDNES.
[Flatio.cz](https://www.flatio.cz/) — monthly furnished rentals with no deposit.
